text:
Maya: Heads-up 0 final social plan for the product launch + webinar. Need: X copy (pulse + thread), LinkedIn longpost, hero assets, who handles engagement outreach, and HubSpot routing. We also want to test a short-thread vs single-post format on X.

Tom: I'll knock out the X drafts. Thinking:
- Pulse (1 line) to anchor
- Follow-up 4-tweet thread with benchmark chart screenshot + webinar CTA

Priya: LinkedIn long post + TL;DR bullets. Will craft two tone variants (technical vs product).

Sam: Routing: HubSpot form + Zapier flow to tag social leads "social_launch_q2" and set owner to SDR rotation. Send me the form link + UTM scheme and I'll wire the Zap.

Oliver: Asset ask from design: hero 1200x628, square 1080, LinkedIn header. Also need a tiny PNG for X card and the .psd. Can we get 2 color palette options?

DesignOps: Confirmed 0 we'll deliver PSD + exports in two palettes by Tue EOD.

Maya: Proposed schedule (please confirm):
- X pulse: Mon 09:30 PT
- X thread: Mon 09:40 PT
- LinkedIn longpost: Tue 10:00 PT
- LinkedIn reminder: Thu 11:00 PT
Goal: morning engagement across timezones.

Tom: I'll A/B the thread length. Short thread hypothesis: higher RTs. Long thread hypothesis: deeper sign-ups.

Priya: Messaging anchor for benchmark line: "3x inference cost reduction while maintaining 90th pct latency SLA" 0 is that accurate?

Sam: That wording is fine. For analytics, use UTMs: utm_source={platform}, utm_medium=social, utm_campaign=redwood_launch_q2. Example link: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=redwood_launch_q2

Maya: Engagement follow-ups 0 Lina (copied elsewhere) suggested: auto DM/comment reply within 24h with webinar link, and SDR follow-up for leads scoring >=60. We need templates.

Oliver: Paid amp workflow: I need final copy + hero by Wed EOD to submit to paid channels.

postbot: draft-checker 0 draft Buffer items created (buf_102334) 0 still in drafts.

Maya: Owners & deadlines:
- Tom: X copy variants (due today EOD)
- Priya: LinkedIn posts (due today EOD)
- DesignOps: assets (Tue EOD)
- Sam: HubSpot form + test Zap (Wed AM)
- Oliver: paid submission (Wed EOD)

Tom: I'll upload X drafts to the shared drive and annotate which to use for paid.

DesignOps: Will include alt text suggestions and image accessibility notes.

Sam: I'll spin up a test Zap and do a dry run to the SDR queue before we go live.

Maya: One last thought 0 should we pin a canonical X post with the webinar link and benchmark graphic? That makes replies consistent.

Oliver: Yes, pin canonical thread and reference thread ID in all scripts.

Maya: Cool. If there are no blockers we'll proceed on this timeline. Close thread once assets + final copy are in drive. Thanks team :rocket:
